description: Convert cat years to human years with the accepted life-stage chart: 15 for year one, 9 for year two, then about 4 per year.

faqs.a: The widely used veterinary chart: the first year of a cat's life equals 15 human years, the second year adds 9, and each year after adds about 4.
faqs.q: How many human years is one cat year?

faqs.a: Kitten (0–1), junior (1–2), prime (3–6), mature (7–10), senior (11–14), geriatric (15+). The tool labels your cat's stage automatically.
faqs.q: What are the cat life stages?

faqs.a: Indoor cats commonly live 13–17 years; outdoor cats average far less. Neutering, diet and preventive care are the biggest factors — ask your vet for advice.
